bullets.title: META: Cloud compute launch sparks 9% rally; JPM downgrades to Neutral, MS bullish on EPS optionality
bullets.body: META surged ~9% after announcing 'Meta Compute' — a plan to sell excess AI capacity (hosted models + raw GPU) to third parties. Morgan Stanley sees every 250MW leased at $40/Watt adding ~$3 (8%) to 2028 EPS, with META bringing 2GW/3.5GW incremental capacity in 2026/2027. JPM downgraded META to Neutral (at $725 PT, action taken Apr 30) and prefers META deploy AI for its 4B users rather than sell infrastructure; buyside 2027 capex estimates range $175B-$275B vs Street $160B.

bullets.title: CRWV/NBIS: -14%/-17% on META cloud competition; Roth calls selloff an overreaction
bullets.body: CoreWeave and Nebius fell 14% and 17% respectively as META's cloud launch positions it as a direct neocloud competitor. Roth views the selloff as overdone, citing near-term GPU demand running ahead of supply and signals from Anthropic-SpaceX, Google-SpaceX deals and AWS raising GPU rates. DA Davidson flagged broader compute infrastructure negative ripple risk.

bullets.title: AAPL: Sourcing memory from sanctioned Chinese suppliers CXMT/YMTC; iPhone production 'well above' 220M
bullets.body: Apple is in talks to purchase DRAM from ChangXin Memory (CXMT) and Yangtze Memory (YMTC) — both on the Pentagon's 1260H blacklist — to offset the DRAM supply crunch as suppliers shift capacity to HBM for AI. Apple is lobbying Washington for political cover. Separately, Nikkei reports CY26 iPhone production 'well above' 220M units with 5+ models and 10M foldables; spring 2027 iPad Pro and MacBook updates also in testing.

bullets.title: NVDA: Revenue-sharing cloud partnership model launched; AI infrastructure TAM revised sharply higher by JPM
bullets.body: NVIDIA is introducing a revenue-sharing/credit-support model with AI cloud partners (e.g., Sharon AI deploying 40K GB300 GPUs; Firmus building 360MW Indonesia campus with 170K GPUs), giving NVIDIA a recurring usage-linked earnings stream. JPM revised AI server TAM to $473B in 2026 (+67% YoY, +31% CAGR through 2030); NVDA holds 50% AI DC switch share.

bullets.title: ADBE: HSBC upgrades to Buy, PT $308 (46% upside from $211)
bullets.body: HSBC analyst Stephen Bersey upgraded ADBE from Hold to Buy and raised the price target to $308 from $282, representing ~46% upside from the $210.98 close. Stock was up ~1.9% in pre-market on the upgrade.

bullets.title: PLTR: DA Davidson upgrades to Buy; stock +2.4% pre-market
bullets.body: DA Davidson analyst Gil Luria upgraded Palantir to Buy. No updated price target was specified in the sources. PLTR was up 2.4% in pre-market trading on the action.

bullets.title: HOOD: Mizuho raises PT to $130 on global brokerage hyperscaler thesis; Piper reiterates OW at $135
bullets.body: Mizuho raised HOOD PT to $130 (from $115), framing Robinhood as a potential 'global hyperscaler of online brokerages' with 27M+ funded accounts expanding into Europe, Canada, and Asia. Piper reiterates Overweight at $135, noting HOOD is tracking a record month in equities/options/event contracts and has launched perpetual futures on real-world assets in the EU via Bitstamp with up to 10x leverage. KeyBanc also bullish on crypto/DeFi expansion (Robinhood Chain, 7% APY Earn product) with PT under review.

bullets.title: GOOGL: EU's top court upholds €4.13B Android antitrust fine
bullets.body: The European Court of Justice dismissed Google's appeal and upheld the €4.13B ($4.70B) fine for requiring Android device makers to preinstall Google Search and Chrome, confirming intentional infringement. The fine was slightly reduced from the original €4.34B in 2022. GOOGL fell ~1% in pre-market on the news.

bullets.title: NVDA/MU/ANET/DELL/SMCI: JPM raises AI infrastructure TAM; DELL server share surges to 21%
bullets.body: JPM's industry model revision shows server market at $473B in 2026 (+67% YoY) with +31% CAGR through 2030; AI DC switch market +116% YoY to $24B. DELL server share jumped to 21% (1Q26) from 10% a year ago; SMCI at 9%. ANET holds 22% of total DC Ethernet. AEC market (CORZ at 82% share) growing +121% YoY. DCI market revised +15%/+22%/+28% higher for 2026/2027/2028 vs prior.

bullets.title: MU: Retail buyers top $897M in purchases; memory ASPs surging with shortage to persist past 2027
bullets.body: Micron topped retail purchases last week at $897M (+3.7z) after blockbuster earnings and expansion of Strategic Customer Agreements from 1 to 16 contracts. PC DDR4 (8Gb) hit $21 in June (5% MoM, 7x YoY); Samsung HBM4E yields exceed 70% for NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra. Micron CEO warned supply crunch will persist beyond 2027; Micron investing ~$200B in manufacturing and R&D.

bullets.title: AMZN: Leo satellite constellation at 396 satellites, on track for mid-2026 commercial availability
bullets.body: JPM notes Amazon's Project Kuiper (Leo) has 396 satellites deployed and is on track for mid-2026 commercial availability. Separately, Amazon is designing custom AI chips for Echo, Fire TV, and mobile devices.

bullets.title: ASML: GS raises FY27-30 estimates 5-9% on stronger memory capex; Buy reiterated ahead of July 15 earnings
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs raised ASML FY27-30 revenue, gross profit, and EBIT estimates by 5-9% (EPS +5-8%) driven by Micron's $27B FY26 capex with step-up in FY27 and Samsung's $2.45T 2026-40 plan (76% semis). FY26 estimates unchanged. GS notes ASML's 90-tool EUV guide may be conservative vs. 110-120 potential in 2028. Jefferies separately raised ASML PT to €1,560 from €1,260.

bullets.title: RCL/CCL: UBS sees Q3 yield downside for RCL; CCL cut 100bps on European demand; NCLH issues persist
bullets.body: UBS is near flat on RCL Q3 yields in constant FX vs. consensus +1%, flagging downside risk from prolonged Mideast conflict impact on bookings. CCL lowered FY yield guidance 100bps; it has 34% of Q4 itineraries in Europe vs. 10% for RCL. NCLH's 300-500bps guidance cut reflects execution issues expected to persist into 1H27; UBS maintains Neutral on NCLH at $17 PT. RCL's Perfect Day Mexico delayed to late 2027/Q1 2028.

bullets.title: DKNG: Citi raises estimates on Q2 strength; World Cup June tracking strong
bullets.body: Citi raised EBITDA estimates for PENN, MGM, RRR but lowered for DKNG and WYNN. Overall online gaming GGR was +10% QTD through Q2, in line with Q1; sports betting GGR estimated mid-single-digit YoY for Q2. JPM's digital gaming digest shows May OSB GGR -2% YoY but June tracking much stronger on World Cup — NY OSB handle +33% YoY MTD. Citi views DKNG as significant value if OSB rebounds; Q2 Street estimates (+6% handle) viewed as within reach.

bullets.title: TSLA: June US sales ~37K units, -27% YoY; BEV penetration fell to 5.3%
bullets.body: June US auto SAAR hit 16.5M (above JPM est. 16.2M) but Tesla delivered only ~37K units (-27% YoY) and Rivian ~3.6K (-9% YoY). BEV penetration fell to 5.3% from 5.8% in May and 7.9% in June 2025. Chinese brands are taking 12.5% W. Europe market share (+4.6ppt YoY), with BYD leading NEV gains.

bullets.title: WBD/FOXA/DIS: TV ratings surge on NBA/World Cup; WBD down 21%, Fox FS1 +127%
bullets.body: UBS TV ratings data shows traditional TV viewership up ~6% QTD (best since pandemic) driven by sports. Disney networks up 7% YoY QTD (ESPN +5%, ABC +66%). WBD viewership fell 21% in Q2 (vs. -12% in Q1) due to NBA playoff comp lap. Fox cable -5% YoY but FS1 +127% on World Cup; estimated ~$500M Fox ad revenue from group stage. World Cup A18-49 demo up 83% YoY.

bullets.title: GS TMT Momentum Pair -10%+ amid Asia tech selloff; AI infrastructure positioning stretched
bullets.body: GS TMT Momentum Pair fell 10%+ (High Beta Momo -9.62%) in a second drawdown in a week. Korea fell 8%, Japan -2.5%, China -2% overnight on AI overcapacity fears. JPMorgan and GS flagged stretched AI infrastructure positioning and seasonal headwinds; software vs. semis ratio bounced 9% from -59% YTD lows. Hedgeye warns QQQ at lower cycle highs with -8% implied vol discount vs. realized.

bullets.title: BABA: Agrees to pay $600M to resolve US probe into illegal product sales
bullets.body: Alibaba agreed to pay $600M to resolve a US government probe into illegal product sales on its platform. No further details on timeline or product categories were disclosed in the sources.

bullets.title: APP: UBS maintains Buy at $200 PT after NAA conference; AI disruption risk limited near term
bullets.body: UBS conducted channel checks at the NAA Apartmentalize conference and found AI adoption still early (~45% of customers not yet using/testing); AppFolio's Lisa flagged as credible alongside RealPage's Knock. Unit growth expectations averaged ~17% YoY, supporting APP's 7-8% guide. Cross-sell/ARPU growth moderating from low-teens. PT maintained at $200 on 21x CY27e EV/FCF.

bullets.title: RDDT: -1.2% to -4.2% pre-market on AI infrastructure sentiment; prior +14% attributed to risk-on unwind
bullets.body: Reddit fell 1.2%-3.9% in pre-market as consumer tech names sold off alongside AI infrastructure weakness. JPM noted RDDT's prior +14% move was driven by risk-on sentiment unwind rather than fundamentals.
